paper_metadata.title: Enhancing Quantum Machine Learning Algorithms for Optimized Financial Portfolio Management

summary: The paper proposes a gate-based QSVM for financial portfolio management using Python, Min-Max normalization, quantum circuit optimization, and noise mitigation. It reports portfolio performance over time of 89.65%, risk-return tradeoff of 25%, and efficiency frontier of 32.12%, but does not provide hardware details, qubit counts, or any demonstrated computational speedup.
